title: Distributionally Adaptive Regression Estimator under Local Linear
text: Least squares regression can inefficient error distribution far Gaussian, example heavy tails outliers. distributionally adaptive regression estimator (DARE) Dai (2025) estimates conditional mean E[Y∣X=x0]E[Y \mid X = x_0] weighted combination conditional quantiles levels k/(K+1)k/(K+1), k=1,…,Kk = 1, \dots, K. weights adapt unknown error distribution, number quantiles KK chosen cross-validation. regularity conditions DARE attains asymptotic variance infeasible likelihood-based estimator keeping convergence rate conventional estimators. DARELL implements local linear version DARE. Conditional quantiles target point estimated kernel-weighted local linear quantile regression, weights come kernel estimates conditional density quantile. estimate comes standard error 95% confidence interval. Documentation: https://shengtao-dai.github.io/DARELL/

title: Distributionally Adaptive Regression Estimator under Local Linear
code: library(DARELL)  # Simulated data with heavy-tailed (t, 3 df) errors; the true m(0, 0) is 0.5 set.seed(123) n <- 200 X <- cbind(rnorm(n), rnorm(n)) Y <- as.numeric(0.5 + X %*% c(1, -1) + rt(n, df = 3))  res <- local_eq_estimate(Y, X, x0 = c(0, 0), K_grid = c(1, 3, 5), L = 2) unlist(res) #>       m_hat_local_eq     cov_hat_local_eq m_hat_local_eq_lower #>           0.49267987           0.29562481          -0.08674475 #> m_hat_local_eq_upper #>           1.07210450
